new_libraries.name: RFDO
new_libraries.author: Lautaro Ezequiel Rodriguez Base lerb.dev@gmail.com
new_libraries.sentence: Library for sending and receiving data to N nRF24 devices.
new_libraries.paragraph: This library allows you sending and receiving data from N (max 256) devices nRF24 as a fast Half Duplex communication.

library.name: APIOTA
library.author: APIOTA <support@apiota.net>
library.sentence: ESP32 OTA Update + Device Provisioning + Command Polling via apiota.net
library.paragraph: Header-only library for secure OTA firmware updates with RSA-2048 signature verification, SHA-256 checksum, device provisioning, long-poll command queue, and NVS credential storage. Works with any ESP32 board.

library.name: DeterministicESPAsyncWebServer
library.author: Douglas Quigg (dstroy0) <dquigg123@gmail.com>
library.sentence: Zero-heap, asynchronous multi-protocol network server for ESP32 with a fully deterministic memory footprint.
library.paragraph: Serves RFC 7230 HTTP/1.1 (routes matched in insertion order; the parser validates every request byte-by-byte and auto-sends 400/413/414/501 with no application code), WebSocket (RFC 6455), Server-Sent Events, Basic/Digest auth, static file serving, multipart, JSON, templating, and a middleware pipeline, plus opt-in HTTPS/TLS, SSH, Telnet, and SNMP (v1/v2c/v3). All buffers are statically sized at compile time and no heap is used after begin(); feature flags strip unused subsystems.
